# Kiln

> Isolated Linux microVMs on one host. A sandbox boots from a template snapshot in under a second, forks into copies, sleeps, and serves a port on a public hostname.

Authenticate every call with `Authorization: Bearer <api key>`. A key names one tenant, and a call only ever reaches that tenant's rows.

## Machine readable

- [OpenAPI](https://api.example.com/openapi.json): every route, body and error code.
- [MCP](https://api.example.com/mcp): the same operations as tools, over Streamable HTTP.
- [Catalog](https://api.example.com/.well-known/ai-catalog.json): this index, in one file.
- [Full documentation](https://api.example.com/llms-full.txt): every operation with its fields.

## The shortest path to a running sandbox

1. `POST /v1/templates` builds a template from an OCI image. It answers 202 and builds after the answer.
2. `GET /v1/templates/{name}` until `state` is `ready`.
3. `POST /v1/sandboxes` restores that template into a sandbox.
4. `POST /v1/sandboxes/{id}/exec` runs a command. Send `Accept: text/event-stream` to read output as it runs.
5. `POST /v1/sandboxes/{id}/publish` serves a guest port on a public hostname.
6. `DELETE /v1/sandboxes/{id}` destroys it. Nothing is left behind.

## Errors

Every error is `{"error":{"code":"...","message":"..."}}`. The code is stable: `invalid`, `not_found`, `conflict`, `exhausted`, `internal`. `exhausted` means a cap of this tenant is reached; the message names the cap. `not_found` also covers a row of another tenant.

## Operations

### events

`GET /v1/events`

Read the event stream of this tenant.

This call can stream. Read the body as it arrives.

Answers 200 with `EventList`.

### health

`GET /v1/health`

Report whether the host can run sandboxes.

Answers 200 with `Health`.

### listSandboxes

`GET /v1/sandboxes`

List the sandboxes of this tenant.

Answers 200 with `SandboxList`.

### createSandbox

`POST /v1/sandboxes`

Create a sandbox by restoring a template snapshot.

Body:

- `template` (string, required): Template the sandbox restores from.
- `lifecycle` (string): ephemeral or persistent.
- `ttl_seconds` (integer): Seconds until the sandbox is destroyed.
- `idle_seconds` (integer): Seconds of inactivity until the sandbox sleeps.
- `metadata` (object): Free-form labels the caller reads back.
- `secrets` (array of string): Names of host secrets to inject.

Answers 201 with `Sandbox`.

### deleteSandbox

`DELETE /v1/sandboxes/{id}`

Destroy a sandbox and retire its hostnames.

Path:

- `id` (string): Sandbox id.

Answers 204 with no body.

### getSandbox

`GET /v1/sandboxes/{id}`

Read one sandbox with its published ports.

Path:

- `id` (string): Sandbox id.

Answers 200 with `Sandbox`.

### exec

`POST /v1/sandboxes/{id}/exec`

Run a command inside a sandbox. Accept text/event-stream to read the output as it runs.

This call can stream. Read the body as it arrives.

Path:

- `id` (string): Sandbox id.

Body:

- `cmd` (array of string, required): Command and its arguments.
- `cwd` (string): Directory the command runs in.
- `env` (object): Extra environment variables.
- `timeout_seconds` (integer): Seconds until the command is killed.

Answers 200 with `ExecResult`.

### readFile

`GET /v1/sandboxes/{id}/files/{path...}`

Read one file out of a sandbox.

This call can stream. Read the body as it arrives.

Path:

- `id` (string): Sandbox id.
- `path` (string): Path inside the sandbox.

Answers 200 with `FileBody`.

### writeFile

`PUT /v1/sandboxes/{id}/files/{path...}`

Write one file into a sandbox.

This call can stream. Read the body as it arrives.

Path:

- `id` (string): Sandbox id.
- `path` (string): Path inside the sandbox.

Answers 204 with no body.

### fork

`POST /v1/sandboxes/{id}/fork`

Snapshot a running sandbox and restore several copies of it.

Path:

- `id` (string): Sandbox id.

Body:

- `count` (integer, required): Number of copies.
- `allow_secret_fork` (boolean): Allow a fork of a sandbox that holds secrets.

Answers 201 with `SandboxList`.

### publish

`POST /v1/sandboxes/{id}/publish`

Serve a guest port on a public hostname.

Path:

- `id` (string): Sandbox id.

Body:

- `port` (integer, required): Port inside the sandbox.
- `visibility` (string, required): public or team.

Answers 201 with `Published`.

### retire

`DELETE /v1/sandboxes/{id}/publish/{port}`

Retire a published hostname. It answers 404 from then on.

Path:

- `id` (string): Sandbox id.
- `port` (integer): Published guest port.

Answers 204 with no body.

### snapshot

`POST /v1/sandboxes/{id}/snapshot`

Snapshot a sandbox. With stop the sandbox sleeps and keeps its hostnames.

Path:

- `id` (string): Sandbox id.

Body:

- `stop` (boolean): Stop the sandbox after the snapshot.

Answers 201 with `SnapshotCreated`.

### listSnapshots

`GET /v1/snapshots`

List the snapshots of this tenant.

Answers 200 with `SnapshotList`.

### deleteSnapshot

`DELETE /v1/snapshots/{id}`

Delete a snapshot that has no live sandbox.

Path:

- `id` (string): Snapshot id.

Answers 204 with no body.

### getSnapshot

`GET /v1/snapshots/{id}`

Read one snapshot.

Path:

- `id` (string): Snapshot id.

Answers 200 with `Snapshot`.

### restore

`POST /v1/snapshots/{id}/restore`

Restore a snapshot into one or more new sandboxes.

Path:

- `id` (string): Snapshot id.

Body:

- `count` (integer, required): Number of sandboxes.
- `allow_secret_fork` (boolean): Allow a restore of a snapshot that holds secrets.

Answers 201 with `SandboxList`.

### listTemplates

`GET /v1/templates`

List the templates of this tenant.

Answers 200 with `TemplateList`.

### createTemplate

`POST /v1/templates`

Build a template from an OCI image. The build runs after the answer.

Body:

- `name` (string, required): Name of the template inside this tenant.
- `image` (string, required): OCI image reference, for example docker.io/library/python:3.12-slim.
- `vcpus` (integer): Virtual CPUs of every sandbox from this template.
- `memory_mb` (integer): Memory of every sandbox from this template.
- `disk_mb` (integer): Disk of every sandbox from this template.
- `setup` (array of string): Commands that run once while the template builds.
- `egress_allow` (array of string, required): Hostnames a sandbox may reach. An empty list allows no egress.

Answers 202 with `TemplateState`.

### deleteTemplate

`DELETE /v1/templates/{name}`

Delete a template that has no live sandbox and no snapshot.

Path:

- `name` (string): Name of the template.

Answers 204 with no body.

### getTemplate

`GET /v1/templates/{name}`

Read one template.

Path:

- `name` (string): Name of the template.

Answers 200 with `Template`.

### createViewer

`POST /v1/viewers`

Add a viewer of this tenant. A viewer opens team previews and nothing else.

Body:

- `email` (string, required): Address the viewer signs in with.
- `password` (string, required): Password of the viewer.

Answers 201 with `Viewer`.
